sources.title: AnuarSv/kokoro-tts-kazakh · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A single-speaker Kazakh text-to-speech voice, built by fine-tuning Kokoro-82M on the ISSAI KazakhTTS2 corpus with a StyleTTS2 -based training pipeline (kikiri-tts).

sources.title: Kazakh Kokoro TTS Fine-Tuning - GitHub
sources.snippet: Kazakh Kokoro TTS Fine-Tuning Fine-tuning and CPU inference experiments for a Kazakh-language Kokoro / StyleTTS2-based text-to-speech model. The project includes dataset preparation, fine-tuning configuration, Kokoro-format checkpoint conversion, Kazakh inference, and ONNX Runtime export and benchmarking.

sources.title: GitHub - hukkum/kokoro-tts: Kokoro Web: Free AI text-to-speech ...
sources.snippet: 🧠 Model Kokoro Web is powered by hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, an open-weight 82 million parameter Text-to-Speech model available on Hugging Face. Despite its lightweight architecture, it delivers comparable quality to larger models while being significantly faster and more cost-efficient.
